card.name: Just before -ine or inequality endings
card.fires_on: Words right before a predicted 'ine' ending in a drug or chemical name, or before 'inequality' or 'misallocation' in economics essays about globalization.

modes.label: Inside -ine names
modes.description: Partway through chemical or drug names where the next piece is 'ine'.

modes.label: Before inequality
modes.description: Words in economics text that lead into 'inequality' or similar terms.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of 'ine' and 'inequality' endings as the next piece.
card.plain: It marks spots where a word like -ine or inequality is about to come next, in drug names and in essays on economic inequality.
